# FNB-ETAF API, database, file-data, and PDF guidance

- Store API requests, request bodies, headers, database queries, CSV/XML data, ZIP settings, and PDF expectations in their approved resources. Keep features concise.
- Validate expected API response statuses and meaningful response content. A 4xx or 5xx response is a failure unless an approved negative test explicitly expects it.
- Use parameterized database access and preserve connection cleanup. Never embed credentials or real connection values in generated code.
- Do not log raw authorization values, passwords, account data, or confidential file content.
- Preserve existing CSV, XML, ZIP extraction/conversion, and PDF validation behavior when adding a new data use case.
